reason_none_accepted: No screen-passing unreviewed family yielded a pair of two distinct natural sequences with documented, motif-free constructs. Taxa=2 families: THF (RF01831) both natural groups carry internal engineering (S. mutans P4 replaced by tetraloop + P1 terminal GC pairs; E. siraeum internal 14/65/85 noncanonical->WC changes); CPEB3 (RF00622) U1A-binding module in P4 and crystal-packing loss of P1.1, sequences differ by 1 nt; PrrB_RsmZ (RF00166) one side is an NMR two-conformer ensemble and the other has an unexplained 1-nt indel vs PAO1/PA14. ZMP-ZTP (RF01750) is the closest candidate (3 species, X-ray, full coverage) but both full-coverage constructs differ internally from their claimed source genomes and both papers were inaccessible (captcha). All other families: single natural source, designed variants, artificial sequences, or observed fraction < 0.90.
